## Duplicate Advisory

This advisory has been withdrawn because it is a duplicate of GHSA-53fp-9jmv-227g. This link is maintained to preserve external references.

## Original Description
SiYuan versions before v3.7.4 contain an information disclosure vulnerability in the /api/storage/getOutlineStorage endpoint that performs no authorization checks. Attackers can retrieve outline state including heading identifiers for any document by supplying its identifier, even for documents forbidden to the requester.
Advisory.Summary: Duplicate Advisory: Outline state for any document, including documents forbidden to readers, is returned by /api/storage/getOutlineStorage with no access check
